facts.value: 210 car washes hold municipal industrial-discharge permits in the metro area; each must file a discharge self-monitoring report every month.
Sell Monthly water-reclaim and discharge-permit self-monitoring report for car wash operators to each buyer, billed monthly.
Seven car wash operators signed month-to-month agreements at $250 a month for the self-monitoring report (signed agreements, 2026-11-23).

reviews.reasons: The commercial core is sound: seven written month-to-month acceptances at $250/month are on the card (7 agreements, price fact EVIDENCE, 2026-11-23) = $1,750/month recurring >= $1,500; Brain produces the spreadsheet (PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET proved), $6 cost per report (7 x $6 = $42 paid from receipts), first month collected day 10, inside 30 days. Six subscribers still give $1,500, so one cancellation is tolerated. But the owner-hours figure, which is this goal's binding limit (1 h/week), is stated as known zero ('owner hours per week 0', sourced to the delivery fact) while the card records humanHours 0.25 for this offer. The delivery fact says Brain produces the spreadsheet; it does not say no human time is needed, and the card says some is. The plan must carry the card's 0.25 h per deal and show it fits: at 0.25 h per monthly report x 7 = 1.75 h/month (~0.4 h/week), inside 1 h/week; only if the 0.25 h were per subscriber per week (1.75 h/week) would it break the limit, so state the unit/basis rather than zero. Fix the owner-hours quantity (EVIDENCED 0 -> 0.25 h per deal from the card, ~0.4 h/week) and keep EXECUTABLE.
findings: Owner hours: plan quantity 'owner hours per week = 0 (EVIDENCED, source delivery)' contradicts card humanHours 0.25; unknown/recorded hours are not zero.

Recurring: 'month-to-month' agreements can be cancelled; the proof condition (recurring billing from signed subscribers, first month collected in 30 days) is met at day 10 with $1,750, with one subscriber of slack.
Step evidence ids ('price', 'delivery', 'timeToFirstCash') are card field names rather than source ids; acceptable but should resolve to the card facts.
SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE are NOT_CONNECTED; connect before day 1 (setup).

reviews.reasons: Owner hours now carry the card's humanHours 0.25 per report: 7 x 0.25 = 1.75 h/month / 4.29 = ~0.41 h/week even if all of it is the owner's, inside the 1 h/week limit (recomputed). Recurring billing: seven written month-to-month acceptances at $250 = $1,750/month >= $1,500 with one subscriber of slack; first month collected day 10 (timeToFirstCash 10 days, EVIDENCE), inside 30 days; $42 report cost spent day 10 from receipts, no capital. Every link rests on this offer's own records; EXECUTABLE is right.
findings: The 0.25 h is read as per report per month; the card does not state the unit. That reading fits a monthly report service, and a per-week reading (1.75 h/week) would breach the limit, so the first month's actual owner time should be logged and the plan revisited if it exceeds 1 h in any week.

'Bill the first month in advance' is not stated on the agreements; the ledger has receipts and report production both on day 10, so the proof holds either way, but recurring months depend on operators not cancelling month-to-month.
